description: Blueprint for Nova autonomous Leah capability build. Nova reads this file when a leah_ capability gap is dispatched and uses it to generate the correct implementation.

context.upload_endpoint_status: POST /api/chat/upload is called by leah.js but has no handler in nova_http.py
context.upload_handler_available: LEAH_FRONTDOOR_SERVICE.ingest_items(session_id, user_id, items) returns list of stored item dicts
context.compose_chat_status: LEAH_FRONTDOOR_SERVICE.compose_chat_message(message, attachments) exists but is never called in /api/chat POST path
context.session_context_status: LEAH_FRONTDOOR_SERVICE.remember_session_context() and recent_session_context() exist but are unwired

leah_voice_persona_engine.purpose: Leah can speak with a stable voice persona and response style across turns

files.intent: Voice persona settings (name, tone, pacing, style), TTS dispatch coordination using tools/tts_say.py, and per-session voice preference storage. Expose a simple API: get_persona_config(session_id) -> dict, speak(text, session_id) -> ok bool.
Default persona profile: name=Leah, tone=warm-direct, pacing=measured, style=conversational. Support operator overrides via runtime/leah_persona.json if present.

leah_voice_persona_engine.integration_hint: nova_http.py already imports LeahFrontdoorService. Add voice engine calls in the /api/chat POST response path after Nova replies.

leah_memory_recall.purpose: Leah can retrieve prior conversation facts and user preferences for continuity

files.intent: Session memory retrieval, fact recall, and user preference continuity. Read from memory/ dir (identity.json, learned_facts.json). Expose: recall_facts(user_id) -> list[str], recall_session_summary(session_id) -> str. Return empty gracefully if memory files absent.

leah_memory_recall.integration_hint: Memory files live under the MEMORY_DIR constant in nova_http.py. LeahFrontdoorService.recent_session_context() returns staged items from the current session — complement it with recalled facts from prior sessions.

leah_emotional_state_model.purpose: Leah tracks a simple server-side emotional state that influences reply tone

files.intent: 5-state model mirroring leah.js mood keys: calm/sensing/focus/synthesis/strain. Persist current state per session in runtime/leah_emotion_{session_id}.json. Expose: get_state(session_id) -> str, update_state(session_id, event: str) -> str. Events: user_upload, voice_active, thinking_start, thinking_done, error, idle.

leah_emotional_state_model.integration_hint: State should be included in /api/chat reply payload as leah_mood so leah.js can call setMood() to sync client state with server state.

leah_conversation_continuity.purpose: Leah maintains context across turns and can stitch sessions together

files.intent: Cross-turn context retention and session stitching. On each /api/chat turn, record a brief turn summary. On session resume, build a handoff summary from the last N turns. Expose: record_turn(session_id, user_msg, nova_reply) -> None, handoff_summary(session_id, n=5) -> str. Store under runtime/leah_sessions/{session_id}.jsonl.

leah_conversation_continuity.integration_hint: nova_http.py /api/chat/resume already supports session resumption. The handoff_summary output should be injected as system context at the top of a resumed session so Nova remembers what was discussed.

wiring_gaps.description: POST /api/chat/upload has no handler — leah.js calls it on every file drop/camera capture but gets a 404
wiring_gaps.fix: In nova_http.py, handle POST /api/chat/upload by parsing JSON body {session_id, user_id, items:[{content_b64, name, mime, source}]}, calling LEAH_FRONTDOOR_SERVICE.ingest_items(session_id, user_id, items), and returning {ok: true, stored: [...]}

wiring_gaps.description: Attachment context never reaches Nova — compose_chat_message() exists but is not called in /api/chat POST path
wiring_gaps.fix: In the /api/chat POST handler, after parsing message and attachments, call LEAH_FRONTDOOR_SERVICE.compose_chat_message(message, attachments) and pass the result as the actual prompt to Nova instead of the raw message

wiring_gaps.description: static/leah_hub.css exists but is not in the static asset routes — hub styling is broken
remember_session_context() is never called after ingest, so recent_session_context() always returns empty
wiring_gaps.fix: After LEAH_FRONTDOOR_SERVICE.ingest_items() returns stored items, call LEAH_FRONTDOOR_SERVICE.remember_session_context(session_id, stored, stage='staged')
